nodes.label: main() / MagickMain()
nodes.desc: The magick binary starts here and hands argv to the wand layer.

nodes.label: MagickCommandGenesis()
nodes.desc: Boots the CLI environment, then loops over the command line.

nodes.label: ProcessCommandOptions()
nodes.desc: Walks argv one token at a time in command-line order.

nodes.label: CLIOption()
nodes.desc: Central dispatcher: maps each option string to a handler by flag class.

nodes.label: "read" option
nodes.desc: Image filename argument becomes a ReadImages() call.

nodes.label: "write" option
nodes.desc: Output filename argument becomes a WriteImages() call.

nodes.label: "-resize" option
nodes.desc: Geometry string parsed, then ResizeImage() invoked on the current image.

nodes.label: ReadImage()
nodes.desc: Finds the right coder and calls its decoder to produce an Image.

nodes.label: WriteImage()
nodes.desc: Finds the encoder for the output format and serializes the Image.

nodes.label: ResizeImage()
nodes.desc: Two-pass separable resampling through filter tables.

nodes.label: GetMagickInfo()
nodes.desc: Coder registry lookup: returns the MagickInfo entry for a format name.

nodes.label: OpenPixelCache()
nodes.desc: Chooses RAM, file-backed map, or disk storage for pixel data.
